payload.title: Seed real items by manual research (decision models, open TTS, then open LLMs)
payload.description: Ryan 2026-10-21: seed real items by manual research until monitoring takes over. Rules and file format: scratchpad seed/SEEDING-RULES.md (copied into this ticket's comments on completion). First pass: ~30 decision models (section decisions), ~20 open TTS (open-weights); open LLMs later. Publish path: Papyrus library save_item/publish_item with IAM authoring, idempotent by slug.
